rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=2, unet_c=16, alpha_init=0.0037, lr=0.0001, epochs=9, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=460, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=720, seed=42, rationale=iter-9 (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol). BASE_ITER=7 (the BEST: itnet_k=3/unet_c=16/alpha_init=0.0037/lr=1e-4/epochs=9/train_n=460/grad_clip=1.0/seed=42, hr 0.336607 / SSIM 0.915241). ONE KNOB: itnet_k 3 to 2 (number of unrolled denoise+DC steps). GENUINELY-UNTRIED architectural knob -- itnet_k pinned at 3 for all 8 iters; data-coverage (train_n 200->460->579), epochs (8->18, plateaued), capacity (unet_c 16->24, regressed) are exhausted, lr is OFF-LIMITS (v3 lr-FRAGILE: lr3e-4 historically COLLAPSED it). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS). (1) TRAJECTORY: iter-1 ep8/tn200/k3 hr 0.268409; iter-2 ep14 0.310054; iter-3 ep18 0.312282 (epochs PLATEAUED +0.0022, SSIM dropped); iter-4 c24/ep9 0.295576 (capacity REGRESSED -> revert c16); iter-5 ep9/tn400 0.328842 (+0.0165 DATA lever); iter-6 ep6/tn579 0.315239 (full data but exposure cut to 6x -> REGRESSED); iter-7 BEST ep9/tn460 hr 0.336607 / SSIM 0.915241 / elapsed 1139.1s (coverage-at-9x-exposure, +0.0078); iter-8 ep7/tn579 0.314928 (full data at 7x still under-trains -> data-coverage EXHAUSTED in-budget; v3 needs >=8-9x exposure full data cannot afford). MAPPED: epochs (plateaued), unet_c (regressed), train_n (best 460), lr (off-limits/fragile), grad_clip (mandatory=1.0). UNTRIED: itnet_k (always 3), alpha_init (always 0.0037), seed (always 42). (2) LIMITER: data-coverage EXHAUSTED in-budget (iter-8 falsifier fired -- full data under-trains at the affordable 7x); the architectural DC-step count itnet_k is the most load-bearing untried knob, and CROSS-SOLVER evidence is strong: itnet v1 (the current Mayo #1 at hr 0.434) won at itnet_k=1 -- fewer DC steps win on noisy LDCT (campaign-state note). v3 has never moved off k=3. (3) ONE KNOB: itnet_k 3 to 2 (single clean step down from the proven k=3 basin -- NOT a 3->1 jump; v3 is fragile and a 2-step architectural change risks collapse like the lr/capacity moves). All else = iter-7 best EXACTLY (unet_c=16, alpha_init=0.0037, lr=1e-4, epochs=9, train_n=460, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42); epochs HELD at 9 (NOT traded up) to keep a clean single-knob read -- the ~220s freed by the cheaper k=2 stack is left under-wall on purpose so the falsifier isolates the k-effect, not extra optimization (if k=2 wins, iter-10 banks the freed budget as epochs). (4) HYPOTHESIS: cutting the unrolled DC count 3 to 2 lifts hr above the iter-7 best 0.336607, because on noisy dense-view LDCT each 2304-view FBP-adjoint DC step re-injects measurement noise (the LD sinogram is the noise source), so fewer DC steps = less noise re-injection = cleaner recon -- the mechanism that made itnet v1 champion at k=1. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.336607 at k=2/ep9/tn460, the v1 fewer-DC-steps-win result does NOT transfer to the v3 end-to-end variant (v3 learned-alpha already balances DC re-injection, or k=3 is needed for the end-to-end gradient path) -> itnet_k lever exhausted for v3, iter-10 tries alpha_init or seed (the last two untried knobs); 0.3366 stands as v3 budget-constrained ceiling. (5) BUDGET (HARD 1200s = train+score): forward() runs k iterations of denoise+dc_step, dc_step is a full 2304-view forward-project + FBP, so per-slice train cost scales ~ with k. From iter-7 (k3/tn460/ep9 -> 1139.1s): fixed 481s + 9*460*per_slice => per_slice_k3 = 0.1590 s/slice; per-k unit = 0.0530 s. At k=2: per_slice = 0.1060 s -> ep9/tn460 = 481 + 9*460*0.1060 = 920s = 15.3 min < 1200s with ~280s headroom. Train-only at ep9 = 439s; max_train_s=720 safe backstop (never truncates -- checks between epochs, fences only runaway slowdown); the 214-slice per-sample val + figure always land inside the 30-min sbatch wall. val=ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; no fov= override). lr HELD at 1e-4 (v3 lr-FRAGILE -- do NOT touch). grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory: 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint inside dc_step overflows otherwise). HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps FBP init + per-sample itnet.projector swap for the k DC steps, bg_target=truth. (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign. Predicted iter-9 hr: 0.34-0.35 if fewer-DC-steps-win transfers from v1; <=0.3366 falsifies -> itnet_k lever exhausted for v3, iter-10 tries alpha_init/seed.
